confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors come from search-result summaries of 2026-dated Alanya cost-of-living and travel-budget guides, cross-checked against Antalya. Sources differ by 20 to 40 percent, and some were quoted in GBP, EUR or TRY and converted to USD at approximate mid-2026 rates I did not verify, so expect about 25 percent either way. Cocktail is set at about twice the beer anchor, a local price relationship used because standard bar prices were not found; beach-club, nightclub and one Antalya club prices serve only as upper and lower checks. Wine_glass is the weakest drink anchor: no restaurant glass price was found, so it is set at about 1.2 times the beer anchor and checked only against bottle prices. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates for July peak season from general knowledge. No accommodation search, live listings or booking pages were checked, so expect about 35 percent either way. The FX figure is the RBA reading for 18 November 2026, taken from a search-result summary; the page itself was not opened.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city was used. Food and drink anchors are Alanya-specific aggregated figures, cross-checked against Antalya (a larger Turkish Mediterranean city, with a crowd-sourced Numbeo index) and European resort cost comparisons. Turkey is transcontinental; Europe is chosen because Turkish Riviera resort pricing is usually benchmarked against Mediterranean European resorts. Accommodation estimates reflect general knowledge of Alanya's July room rates, not comparable listings.
